race.description: Bet365 Tatura Cup Sat Nov 21 Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: SAVETHEBESTTILLAST (10) is overdue for a win and might be over the odds here. Has placed four of the last five, including a near miss this course and distance two back. Should be in the finish and deserves to break through. WAMBEEN (11) missed the frame fresh but was beaten only 1.5 lengths. Strips fitter and is among the better hopes. IMMORTALISED (3) turned in a decent effort last start to finish second over 1600m at Seymour. Racing well and can give this a shake. POSITIVO (7) rates highly and can do much better this time. ANNOTATE (1) is yet to break through this campaign but hasn't been far away including a last start second over 1300m at Corowa. Worth consideration here.
